NVIDIA: The ‘World’s First and Only Growth Value Stock’

NVIDIA’s CEO, Jensen Huang, has positioned the company as the world’s first and only growth value stock. Huang believes that NVIDIA’s expanding AI platform, broad customer base, and infrastructure partnerships will capture the next phase of global AI spending. He predicts that AI infrastructure spending could reach $3 trillion to $4 trillion by 2030.
Oracle’s Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates

Oracle Corp. reported its fiscal 2027 first-quarter results, beating estimates across the board and raising its fiscal-year earnings guidance. The company reported quarterly earnings of $1.92 per share, beating the analyst consensus estimate of $1.74 by 10.34%.

children: Adobe’s Record Q3 Results

Adobe Inc. posted its third-quarter fiscal 2026 results, beating estimates on the top and bottom lines. The company reported adjusted quarterly earnings of $6.13 per share, beating the Street estimate of $6.09. Quarterly revenue came in at $6.76 billion, beating the consensus estimate of $6.69 billion by 1%.
NVIDIA Eyes $10 Billion Investment in Anthropic IPO

NVIDIA is reportedly considering an investment of up to $10 billion in Anthropic’s potential initial public offering. The AI maker is seeking to raise up to $100 billion at a valuation of about $2 trillion.
iPhone 18 Pro: A New Era of AI and Design

Apple’s latest Pro models, the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, were launched with a host of upgrades. While the design language largely mirrors that of the iPhone 17 Pro, the new models introduce two fresh color options — Glacier and Burgundy.
Read the full article here.
iPhone Duo: Apple’s First Foldable iPhone

Apple also unveiled the iPhone Duo, its first-ever foldable iPhone. The device, about the size of a passport, features an internal and external display with matching aspect ratios. The hinge of the iPhone Duo keeps the inner screen flat when open and precisely controls the opening and closing motion, making it Apple’s thinnest iPhone yet when unfolded.
